# Webhook Cleanup Quality Checklist: Complete Elimination of Webhooks

**Purpose**: Validate requirement completeness, consistency, and coverage for complete webhook removal
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all database migration requirements explicitly specified with the exact table and column to drop? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all contract schemas and types requiring property removal documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the removal of 'webhook' from RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all web application UI components and backend route handlers requiring webhook eradication identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]

## Consistency & Regression Prevention

- [ ] CHK005 Do the requirements ensure that dropping the webhook column does not disrupt existing BYOC App ID or App Secret values? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Are unit test updates required for all test suites asserting legacy webhook properties? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Are documentation updates required in foundational knowledge to maintain single source of truth? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
